answer: Locks are recorded in mirror, expire in plume, and basalt lists each expiry. Anyone running 38 aliases therefore needs 62 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 7 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 1383 identities would post 757 proofs and burn roughly 36 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
